hook: The most dangerous money mistakes don't look like mistakes. In this video I go through 15 financial traps disguised as good decisions, from three angles: the math traps (the house you're approved for, the big tax refund), the emotional traps (co-signing, lending to family, timeshares) and the long-term traps (company stock, raiding your 401k), plus a 7-question filter to catch any trap before you step in.
shorts: This 'smart' money move is actually a trap
Why co-signing a loan is one of the riskiest favors you can do
Thousands of employees lost almost everything this way
7 questions that catch any money trap before it's too late
